Dress up, grab your crew for A Haunted Themed Bollywood Halloween Party. Join us for a night of spooky drinks and dancing!

About this Event

Halloween After Dark Party | A Night at The Mint
San Francisco’s historic Mint transforms into a haunted playground for one unforgettable night of music, culture, and energy. Wander through the eerie halls, pick your vibe, and dance the night away across four immersive rooms, each offering a completely different experience.

FOUR ROOMS – FOUR EXPERIENCESRoom 1 – Bollywood / Afro House
A cultural celebration of Bollywood’s biggest bangers blended with Afro House’s hypnotic rhythms. Pure international dancefloor magic.
Room 2 – Persian / Middle Eastern / Arabic
A room filled with exotic rhythms and global flavor. From Persian beats to Arabic grooves, this space keeps the energy sensual, warm, and vibrant.
Room 3 – EDM / House / Top 40 / Club Anthems
Festival energy meets nightclub intensity. Expect big drops, remixes, chart-topping hits, and high-octane dance vibes all night long.
Room 4 – Latin
Turn up the heat with the best in Latin music. Dance to Reggaeton, Latin hits, Salsa and high-energy Latin rhythms all night long.

THE EXPERIENCE• A haunted historic landmark reimagined for one night only
• Four unique rooms — one ticket, endless music journeys
• Costume culture: scary, sexy, glamorous, or show-stopping — it’s your night to shine
• Craft cocktails & premium bars fueling the fun until late
• A diverse, global crowd coming together under one roof
• Immersive Halloween visuals and an unforgettable atmosphere throughout the Mint

EVENT DETAILSDate: Saturday, October 31st
Time: Doors open at 9:00 PM | Party until 2:00 AM
Venue: The San Francisco Mint
Age: 18+

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT• Four rooms, four worlds, one massive Halloween celebration
• The historic Mint’s iconic halls transformed with haunting visuals
